integrity: All-width result proved by a homotopy-pushout gluing induction and an equivariant blockwise homology model. Exhaustive finite computations are secondary tests, not an infinite proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary homotopy type of the inclusion is proved, although the inclusion is an equivariant map; no equivariant homotopy inverse is asserted. The symmetry-quotient calculation is rational and does not determine integral quotient torsion. The previously published nonequivariant sphere classification is explicitly credited.
title: An invariant spherical homology spine for ladder perfect-matching complexes
